text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits and vegetables, and avoid too much sugar or fast food. Second, exercise regularly, even just a 30-minute walk a day makes a difference. Third, get enough sleep—around seven to eight hours each night. Don't forget your mental health; talking to friends or relaxing can reduce stress. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance, so you have time for both your job and your hobbies. These simple habits can help you feel happier, healthier, and more energetic.
